name: flowlines
description: Flowlines agent observability: analyse agent usage, inspect MCP improvement recommendations, instrument MCP servers, and export Claude Code and Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Agent observability for MCP servers and coding agents
interface.longDescription: Connect to your Flowlines workspace to review agent activity, compare releases, investigate sessions, analyse user cohorts, and inspect MCP improvement recommendations. Use production evidence and suggested contract changes to prepare requested repository fixes. Includes MCP instrumentation, coding-agent telemetry, and ingestion diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: What changed in my Flowlines namespace this week?
Use $flowlines-mcp-observability to instrument this MCP server.
Use $flowlines-improve-mcp to inspect recommendations for my MCP and prepare a supported fix.
